ActionId.description: A lowercase hyphenated version 7 UUID identifying one requested action.
ActionId.title: ActionId

Adjustable.description: One thing an adjustment may change.
Adjustable.title: Adjustable

EffectiveBounds.description:
The envelope intersected with the print's manifest.

This is what context reports, so that the agent can see its own limits
before it asks. Computing one is the supervision core's; this crate declares
the shape and nothing that produces it.

allowed.description: The range each adjustable may be set to, inclusive.

EventId.description: A lowercase hyphenated version 7 UUID identifying one event.
EventId.title: EventId

EventKind.description: The name one kind of event is written down under: lowercase snake_case, declared by the domain that owns the event.
EventKind.title: EventKind

EventRecord.description:
One event, as the store holds it and the server serves it.

`raw` holds the bytes exactly as received for an externally sourced event
and is absent for an internally raised one — it is what makes the history
auditable when a normalization turns out to be wrong. `print_id` is
optional, because an externally sourced event may name no print this system
knows.

id.description: This event's identifier, minted by the store.

image.description: The image it arrived with, when it arrived with one.

payload.description: What it carries, in the form its kind declares.

print_id.description: The print it belongs to, when it belongs to one.

raw.description: The bytes exactly as received, for an externally sourced event.

EventSource.description: Where an event came from, as the bare string the domain that raised it declares for itself.
EventSource.title: EventSource

HeaterSnapshot.description:
One heater, as a source reported it.

Every field is optional, because a source that reports no heater at all
reports none of these; each is a plausibility-ranged reported value in
degrees Celsius.

actual_c.description: The temperature the heater is at.

offset_c.description: The offset applied to this heater's target.

target_c.description: The temperature the heater is driving towards.

ImageId.description: A lowercase hyphenated version 7 UUID identifying one image.
ImageId.title: ImageId

ImageRef.description: The handle an image travels in context under.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of its bytes, lowercase hexadecimal.

Intervention.description:
One adjustment made for a bounded time.

`prior_value` is read from the printer snapshot taken before the change, and
is absent when the printer reported none — in which case expiry restores
nothing and the outcome says so rather than guessing a default.

action_id.description: The action that asked for it.

id.description: This intervention's identifier, minted by the store.

print_id.description: The print it was made against.

prior_value.description: What the printer reported before the change, if it reported anything.

restored_at.description: When the prior value was put back, if it was.

InterventionId.description: A lowercase hyphenated version 7 UUID identifying one bounded intervention.
InterventionId.title: InterventionId

InterventionOutcome.description: What became of a bounded change.

oneOf.description: The prior value was put back.
There was no prior value to put back.
Putting the prior value back failed.
Another intervention replaced it before it expired.

JobManifest.description:
What a sliced job declares about itself and about what may be adjusted.

An adjustable the manifest does not name takes the envelope's own range; a
manifest range wider than the envelope's is narrowed to the envelope's and
the narrowing is recorded on the print. A manifest may only narrow.

allowed.description: The range each named adjustable may take, inclusive.

file_name.description: The file this manifest is about, as the slicer named it.

material.description: The material the job is sliced for.

nozzle_diameter_mm.description: The nozzle the job is sliced for, in millimetres.

slicer_profile.description: The slicer profile the job was sliced with.

JobSnapshot.description:
The job a printer reports it is running.

Every field but `state` is optional: an absent one means the source did not
report it.

completion.description:
How far through the print is, as a fraction from zero to one.

Normalized to a fraction here regardless of how the source expresses it.

error.description: The error the source reports, when it reports one.

estimated_print_time_s.description: The whole print's estimated duration, in whole seconds.

file_name.description: The name of the file being printed, as the source reported it.

file_origin.description: Where the file lives, in the source's own vocabulary.

print_time_left_s.description: How long the print has left, in whole seconds.

print_time_s.description: How long the print has been running, in whole seconds.

state.description: The state the source reports the job to be in.

ManifestNarrowing.description: One adjustable whose manifest range was wider than the envelope's.

requested.description: The range the manifest asked for.

PrintId.description: A lowercase hyphenated version 7 UUID identifying one print.
PrintId.title: PrintId

PrintRecord.description:
One print, and the record supervision keys from.

Obico's own print id is carried beside this record's identifier rather than
as it, because a print may be observed before Obico has one.

end_reason.description: Why it ended, if it has.

ended_at.description: When it ended, if it has.

file_name.description: The file being printed, as the source reported it.

id.description: This print's identifier, minted by the store.

narrowings.description: Every manifest range this print narrowed to the envelope's.

obico_print_id.description: Obico's own identifier for the print, when Obico has one.

state.description: The state the print is in.

PrinterSnapshot.description: A printer, as a source reported it at one instant.

bed.description: The bed heater, when the printer reports one.

chamber.description: The chamber heater, when the printer reports one.

connection.description: The state the printer is in.

feedrate_factor.description: The feedrate multiplier, where one means one hundred percent.

flowrate_factor.description: The flowrate multiplier, where one means one hundred percent.

observed_at.description: The instant this observation was taken.

tools.description: The tool heaters, indexed by tool number.

PrinterState.description:
The state a source reports a printer or a print to be in.

The `unknown` arm exists so that a state nobody anticipated is recorded
carrying the source's own word for it rather than lost.

oneOf.description: A state this vocabulary does not name, in the source's own word for it.

max.description: The highest value the range admits, inclusive.

min.description: The lowest value the range admits, inclusive.

Reported.description: A value as a source reported it, flagged when it is outside the plausibility range this crate declares for its field.
Reported.title: Reported

Timestamp.description: An instant in UTC, as an RFC 3339 string with a zero offset.
Timestamp.title: Timestamp

description: Everything a supervision turn is given about one print.

bounds.description: The limits in force, so that the agent can see them before it asks.

job.description: The job, when a snapshot could be taken.

latest_image.description: The most recent image, when there is one.

manifest.description: The manifest, when the print has one.

printer.description: The printer, when a snapshot could be taken.

recent_events.description: A bounded list of this print's events, newest first.

title: PrintContext
